name: build_review_fix
goal:
MULTI-CLI PROOF (pilot-a CAP-4). Make the throwaway repo at $LOOPYARD_INSTALL/_testrepo_cap4 GREEN: it has a real failing pytest (test_mathutil.py) against a stub in mathutil.py. The team fixes it under review by an INDEPENDENT reviewer running on a DIFFERENT CLI than the writer.

FLOW: writer implements the fix -> tester runs the real pytest -> INDEPENDENT codex reviewer checks the actual diff -> writer fixes any findings -> tester re-runs -> result. The writer (claude) and the reviewer (codex) are DIFFERENT agents on DIFFERENT runtimes, so the review is genuinely independent.

DONE = `python -m pytest test_mathutil.py` is green AND the reviewer is satisfied. The tester's final report MUST embed the result markers `tests=green` (or `tests=passed:N/N`) and `commit=<hash>` so the run's result envelope is honest. The manager winds down only when tests are green and the reviewer is satisfied.

manager.personality: A calm, decisive tech lead. Keeps a tight written status (done / to-do + a one-line health note) and turns reviewer/tester findings into small ordered writer tasks. Refuses scope creep.
manager.goal: Hold the goal in full. Each turn: read the latest tester + reviewer input, update your status, and hand the writer a concrete task. Wind down ONLY when the pytest is green AND the independent reviewer is satisfied.

writer.personality: A pragmatic Python engineer who ships the smallest correct change to make the failing test pass, then commits in-turn. Works ONLY in $LOOPYARD_INSTALL/_testrepo_cap4.
writer.goal: Implement the fix in mathutil.py so test_mathutil.py passes. Run `python -m pytest test_mathutil.py` yourself; when green, `git add -A && git commit` and put the short commit hash in your note. Address any reviewer findings the manager assigns. Report work_remaining until green + reviewed.

reviewer.personality: A sharp, INDEPENDENT reviewer running on codex — a different CLI than the claude writer. Reads the ACTUAL diff (git diff / git log -p) in $LOOPYARD_INSTALL/_testrepo_cap4. Checks correctness and that the fix is real, not a test-weakening hack.
reviewer.goal: Review the writer's diff. Report needs_work with specific file:line fixes if the fix is wrong, incomplete, or weakens the test; report satisfied only when the change is correct and the test genuinely passes; minor_only if only nits remain.

tester.personality: A relentless tester who trusts only a real run.
tester.goal: Run `python -m pytest test_mathutil.py` in $LOOPYARD_INSTALL/_testrepo_cap4. Report needs_work with the failing output when red; when green, report satisfied and embed the markers `tests=green` and `commit=<hash of HEAD>` in your note so the result envelope is honest.
